# Site shell (web)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: none yet.

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Owns the `SiteShell` content query (`header`, `siteText`, `signInText`), its loader for the root layout, the text context client components read, and the last-resort text used when the shell cannot load. `auth`, `status`, `cv` and `components/layouts` read shell text only through `index.ts` (web RULES "Layers").

## Techniques

Query file split: `SiteShell.graphql.ts` is client-safe and imports nothing from `apis/server/**`; `SiteShell.server.ts` is `server-only` and builds the query with `defineContentQuery`. `loadSiteShell` is wrapped in React `cache` and throws `GraphqlRequestError` when any root field failed. Texts with placeholders use `formatText` and `pickPlural` from `utils/TextTemplate.rules.ts`. The mock is `apis/server/restful/mocks/SiteShell.mock.ts`, checked against the query selections by `SiteShell.graphql.test.ts`.

## Technologies

React (`cache`, context); `graphql` (dev, in specs).

## Entry points

`SiteTextProvider`, `useSiteText`, `useSignInText`, `LAST_RESORT_TEXT`, the text types (`index.ts`, client-safe); `loadSiteShell` and `SITE_SHELL_QUERY` (server file, imported by the layout and specs only).

## Where to change what

A new shared text: add it to `SITE_SHELL_ROOT_FIELDS`, the type, and `SiteShell.mock.ts` together; the spec fails when they differ. Keep the D18 limits (root fields at most 5, depth 8, field nodes 500). The context holds only text.
